content.definition: Bonds that can be converted into common stock at bondholder's option at specified conversion ratio
content.key_accounting_rule: NO separation of debt and equity components at issuance (all proceeds recorded as debt)
content.rationale: Conversion feature is inseparable from bond (not detachable like warrants)

issuance.entry: DR Cash, CR Bonds Payable (or CR Bonds + CR Premium if issued above face)
issuance.no_equity_component: Do NOT allocate proceeds to equity (unlike detachable warrants)
issuance.example: Issue $100K face convertible bonds for $108K. DR Cash $108K, CR Bonds Payable $108K (or CR Bonds $100K + CR Premium $8K)

conversion_at_maturity.book_value_method: Most common method. Remove carrying amount of bonds, issue stock at that carrying amount. NO gain or loss.
conversion_at_maturity.entry: DR Bonds Payable, DR Premium (or CR Discount), CR Common Stock (par), CR APIC (excess)
conversion_at_maturity.example: Convert $100K face bonds (carrying amount $102K including premium) into 10,000 shares ($1 par). DR Bonds Payable $100K, DR Premium $2K, CR Common Stock $10K, CR APIC $92K

induced_conversion.definition: Issuer offers additional consideration to induce early conversion (sweetener)
induced_conversion.accounting: Recognize EXPENSE for FV of additional consideration
induced_conversion.example: Offer cash bonus $5K to convert early. DR Loss on Induced Conversion $5K, CR Cash $5K (in addition to conversion entry)

conversion_price_vs_market.market_value_method: Alternative method (rarely used). Record stock at market value, recognize gain/loss. NOT GAAP preferred.
conversion_price_vs_market.book_value_method: GAAP method. No gain/loss. Record at carrying amount of bonds.

beneficial_conversion_feature.definition: If conversion price < market price at issuance, creates immediate value to bondholder
beneficial_conversion_feature.accounting: Allocate proceeds: Portion to debt (discount), portion to equity (APIC)
beneficial_conversion_feature.calculation: Intrinsic value = (Market price - Conversion price) × Shares issuable. Limited to proceeds.
beneficial_conversion_feature.example: Issue $100K bonds convertible into 10,000 shares. Market price $12, conversion price $10. Intrinsic value = ($12 - $10) × 10,000 = $20K. DR Discount on Bonds $20K, CR APIC $20K (at issuance).

diluted_eps_impact.if_converted_method: Assume bonds converted at beginning of year (or issuance if later). Add back interest expense (net of tax). Add shares from conversion.
diluted_eps_impact.formula: Adjusted NI = NI + Interest expense × (1 - tax rate). Adjusted shares = Weighted average shares + Shares from conversion.
diluted_eps_impact.antidilution_test: If including convertible bonds increases EPS, it's antidilutive (exclude from diluted EPS)

calculation_example_conversion.facts: $1M face convertible bonds (carrying amount $1.02M including premium), convertible into 100,000 shares ($1 par).
calculation_example_conversion.entry: DR Bonds Payable $1,000K, DR Premium $20K, CR Common Stock $100K, CR APIC $920K
calculation_example_conversion.result: No gain/loss. Equity increases by carrying amount of bonds converted.

calculation_example_diluted_eps.facts: NI $500K. 100K shares outstanding. 1,000 convertible bonds ($1K face each), convertible into 20 shares each (20,000 total shares). Interest 6%, tax 30%. Basic EPS $5.00.

comparison_to_detachable_warrants.convertible_bonds: No separation. All proceeds to debt. Conversion uses book value method (no gain/loss).
comparison_to_detachable_warrants.bonds_with_detachable_warrants: Separate. Allocate proceeds using relative FV. Exercise requires cash payment.

cpa_exam_tips: Convertible bonds: NO allocation at issuance (all proceeds to debt)
Conversion: Book value method (no gain/loss). DR Bonds + Premium/Discount, CR CS + APIC
Induced conversion: Recognize expense for additional consideration (sweetener)
Diluted EPS: If-converted method (add back interest net of tax, add shares)
Beneficial conversion feature: Allocate intrinsic value to equity (creates discount)
Compare to detachable warrants: Convertible bonds are inseparable (no allocation)

conversion_entry_steps: 1. Determine carrying amount of bonds (face + unamortized premium or - unamortized discount)
2. DR Bonds Payable (face) + Premium (or CR Discount)
diluted_eps_steps: 1. Calculate interest savings: Interest expense × (1 - tax rate)
3. Diluted EPS = (NI + Interest savings) / (Shares + Converted shares)
4. Test: If diluted EPS < basic EPS → Include. If diluted > basic → Antidilutive (exclude).
common_mistakes: Allocating proceeds between debt and equity at issuance (should not allocate)
Recognizing gain/loss on conversion (should use book value method with no gain/loss)
Forgetting tax effect on interest add-back for diluted EPS
Including antidilutive convertible bonds in diluted EPS calculation

key_points: Convertible bonds: All proceeds to debt (no allocation to equity)
Conversion: Book value method - DR Bonds/Premium, CR Common Stock/APIC. No gain/loss.
Induced conversion: Expense for additional consideration (sweetener)
Diluted EPS: If-converted method (add interest net of tax, add shares)
Beneficial conversion feature: Allocate intrinsic value to APIC (creates discount)
Compare to detachable warrants: Convertible bonds not separated at issuance
